name: hurwitzZetaEven_one_sub_two_mul_nat
statement: k ≠ 0) (hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : hurwitzZetaEven x (1 - 2 * k) = -1 / (2 * k) * ((Polynomial.bernoulli (2 * k)).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)).eval (x : ℂ)

name: hurwitzZetaOdd_neg_two_mul_nat
statement: k ≠ 0) (hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : hurwitzZetaOdd x (-(2 * k)) = -1 / (2 * k + 1) * ((Polynomial.bernoulli (2 * k + 1)).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)).eval (x : ℂ)
